LanguageData.CC_Settings_TellMessagesADay: Most messages a day from Rimfolk, by kind
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TellMessagesADay_Tip: How many messages Rimfolk shows in a day of each kind of news (people, health, the colony, the world, the land), for each colony. Past it, the rest of the day's messages of that kind come in the evening's Colony news letter instead, so nothing is lost. The same message twice within a few hours is shown once. Important messages are never held back. An ordinary day stays well under the default; it is there for a day when something goes on and on.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TellMessagesADay: Past this, a day's messages of one kind wait for the evening's Colony news.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TellLettersADay: Most letters a day that only tell, by kind
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TellLettersADay_Tip: How many of Rimfolk's letters that only tell you something come in a day, of each kind of news, for each colony. Past it, the rest become lines in the evening's Colony news letter. Letters that ask you to decide something are never held back, and neither is serious news (a serious illness, someone about to leave, a nemesis back).
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TellLettersADay: Past this, a day's letters of one kind become lines in the evening's Colony news; questions always come.
